controls.description: Determine, document, communicate and enforce the product support period and vulnerability-handling lifecycle.
Retain each support-period security update for at least ten years after issue or the remainder of support, whichever is longer.
Provide latest substantially modified software version to eligible prior users free of charge without additional environment-adjustment cost.
Communicate support-period end date and prepare technically feasible end-of-support notification.
Prepare immediate corrective-action, withdrawal or recall evidence where non-conformity is known or reasonably suspected.
Bind security-update/corrective-measure details to the product security evidence chain.
Provide security-update capability including automatic-update behavior where appropriate.
Remediate vulnerabilities without delay and separate security/functionality updates where technically feasible.
Securely distribute authenticated updates with anti-rollback checks and automatic handling where appropriate.
Prepare timely, generally free security-update dissemination and user-advisory evidence.
Produce signed digest-bound secure-update and lifecycle evidence for independent verification.
